name: Fix a Deployment on the wrong cluster
objective: CKA exam-environment skill: every task names the cluster to target. Drill the whole multi-cluster surface harder than the exam — switch contexts, create on the right cluster (never the wrong one), set a context's default namespace, copy a live resource across clusters with get|apply, inspect contexts, and a no-hint diagnose-and-fix of a resource built on the WRONG cluster. Graded exactly, per requirement.

questions.title: Diagnose & fix: a Deployment on the WRONG cluster
questions.teach:
A classic exam slip: a resource meant for cluster2 was created on **cluster1** by mistake. Find the stray, then move it — recreate on the correct cluster and delete the stray copy.

**Gotcha:** grading checks the END state — it must exist on the RIGHT cluster and be gone from the wrong one; a duplicate isn't enough.
questions.prompt:
A Deployment `cache` (image `redis:7`, 1 replica) was supposed to live in namespace `prod` on **cluster2**, but setup put it in namespace `default` on **cluster1** instead. Fix it: `cache` must exist in `prod` on cluster2 and must NOT exist in `default` on cluster1.

Target: Deployment `cache` (redis:7) in prod on cluster2; absent from default on cluster1.
questions.hint: Find the stray: `kubectl --context kind-kindlab -n default get deploy cache`. Recreate on cluster2: `kubectl --context kind-kindlab2 -n prod create deployment cache --image=redis:7`, then `kubectl --context kind-kindlab -n default delete deployment cache`.
questions.solution:
# setup left 'cache' in default on cluster1 by mistake
kubectl --context kind-kindlab2 -n prod create deployment cache --image=redis:7 --replicas=1
kubectl --context kind-kindlab -n default delete deployment cache
# verify: present on cluster2, gone from cluster1
kubectl --context kind-kindlab2 -n prod get deploy cache
kubectl --context kind-kindlab -n default get deploy cache

verification.description: Deployment 'cache' (redis:7) in prod on cluster2 and absent from default on cluster1
